name: ZJK Industrial Co. Ltd.
summary: ZJK Industrial Co., Ltd., through its various subsidiaries, specializes in the manufacturing and global distribution of high-precision fasteners, structural components, and other refined metal parts. The company's operations span the People's Republic of China, Taiwan, Singapore, and the United States, alongside a significant international presence. Its extensive product range encompasses essential items like screws, nuts, and bolts, in addition to specialized offerings such as turning parts, stamped parts, Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machined parts, Surface Mounting Technology (SMT) products, and Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) products. These meticulously crafted components are vital for cutting-edge applications, including new energy vehicles, mobile phones, smartwatches, drones, 5G communication base stations, and a wide array of other electronic devices. Founded in 2011, ZJK Industrial Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Shenzhen, People's Republic of China, and operates as a subsidiary of DNR Technology Co., Ltd.
